forest_entrance.name: Forest Entrance
forest_entrance.description: Dense copper-tinted trees forming a canopy. Narrow winding path through undergrowth.

factory_exterior.name: Overgrown Factory Exterior
factory_exterior.description: Factory walls visible through trees. Vines covering everything. Industrial salvage.

factory_interior.name: Factory Interior
factory_interior.description: Partially collapsed factory floor. Trees growing through the floor and ceiling.

sealed_workshop.name: Sealed Workshop
sealed_workshop.description: Behind the powered door. Intact Old World workshop — surprisingly preserved.

terrain_features.description: Dense copper-tinted canopy — objects_high layer provides shading effect.
Factory building exterior wall. Entry via door.
Green toxic liquid pool inside factory. Damages on contact.
Hidden trail to fungal grove. Optional side area.

general: Dense trees along edges are BLOCKED (cols 0-3 and 31-34 in forest section)
Toxic pool is HAZARD type — energy drain + damage
Sealed workshop door requires pipe puzzle completion

notes: Moderate difficulty zone. First encounter with Rust Wolves.
Pipe puzzle in factory is the first environmental puzzle beyond The Hollow.
Entry from Coppervale south-west arrives at tile (17, 1).
